name: scg-codebase-readiness
description: Audit a repository against the Software Combined standard for an AI-optimised codebase and build a plain-language report.

interface.shortDescription: Check if a codebase is ready for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Map a repository, score 21 questions on structure, consistency, documentation, verification, safe delivery, contracts and API, and hygiene, and build a report anyone can read. It never changes the audited code or its settings.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the codebase-ai-readiness skill to audit the repository at <absolute path>.
